pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Coronation of the Virgin — the crowned Lord seated on the high golden throne with the ranks of saints kneeling on the steps below, the LORD reigns, let the nations tremble
pictures.name: pd_angelico_regeert

pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, Christ in the Storm on the Lake of Galilee — the boat heaved up on the black wave with the sail tearing while the disciples cling on, He is enthroned above the cherubim, let the earth quake
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_beeft

pictures.scene: Andrea Mantegna, The Ascension — Christ carried up in the ring of angels while the watchers are left standing on the ground, great is the LORD in Zion, He is exalted above all the peoples
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_verheven

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Singing Angels — the choir crowded over the open book with their mouths wide in song, let them praise Your great and awesome name, He is holy
pictures.name: pd_eyck_heilig

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Judgement of Solomon — the king leaning from his throne to stop the sword and give the living child back to its mother, the mighty King loves justice, You have established equity
pictures.name: pd_rubens_recht

pictures.scene: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, Jacob Laying Peeled Rods before the Flocks of Laban — Jacob at the watering troughs with the flocks coming down to drink, You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob
pictures.name: pd_murillo_jakob

pictures.scene: Dieric Bouts, Christ in the House of the Pharisee Simon — the woman bowed down at the Lord's feet while the table watches, exalt the LORD our God and worship at His footstool, He is holy
pictures.name: pd_bouts_voetbank

lines.text: He is enthroned above the cherubim;
Great is the LORD in Zion;
He is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them praise Your great and awesome name—
